title: Report a finished acceptance schedule consistently on repeated opt-in
outcome: When schedule POST or MCP opts in again at the same evidence cut and reuses a completed evaluator with a recorded verdict, its response currently projects Evaluating as in progress while list reports Finished. Share the exact terminal projection and verify that repeating opt-in returns the same ID and the finished state without another evaluator or result wait.
acceptance: Repeated opt-in at a recorded terminal result returns the same schedule identity and finished status as list, and leaves the evaluator count and result waits unchanged.
